sources.note: Scholarship page: states the scholarship is for undergraduate and graduate taught programmes only and links the Eligible Programmes 2027 document, which holds the programme list

subject_rule: Limited to the programmes on UCD's published Eligible Programmes list for 2027/28 (undergraduate and graduate taught programmes only; research degrees are not eligible).
notes: No new programmes recorded: the official Eligible Programmes 2027/28 document (a PDF linked from the scholarship page) could not be read by any permitted method, so the stored first-pass lists (about 25 undergraduate and 25 graduate programmes) are NOT complete and need a person to open that PDF in a browser and transcribe or export it.
The scholarship page itself holds no programme list; it only links the Eligible Programmes, Terms and Conditions and Application Instructions PDFs.
not_stated: The programme list on the scholarship page itself (it is only in the linked PDF)
fetch_problems: The Eligible Programmes 2027/28 PDF, the Terms and Conditions 2027/28 PDF and the scholarship page all returned HTTP 403 (CloudFront request blocked) to automated fetchers; in the built-in browser the scholarship page opened but the PDF is served as a file download that cannot be read there. No workaround was attempted because it would mean bypassing the site's access control.
No other official UCD page was found that lists the eligible programmes in HTML.
